name: Rosario Rossallini
original_name: ロザリオ・ロザリーニ
source:
An Agent belonging to the 5/13.

From childhood, Rosario was trained to subsist under a fiercely ascetic lifestyle, leading to her present, uncompromisingly stoic self.
She carries out her duties ever unperturbed, and always level-headed.

[Edited from [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
